'''PC Shredder''' is the subject of this wiki. It is a fast-paced game about shredding armour, and the community has built a vast catalogue of guides.

== Overview ==
The game features multiple armour tiers, each with distinct breakpoints. See [[Armor Info]] for details, and the [[Shredder Hub Invitational]] for the yearly tournament. Founder [[Goober]] maintains the hub.

== Gameplay ==
Players choose a loadout and try to break armour as quickly as possible.
# Pick a tier
# Choose a shredder
# Break the armour
#* Fastest break wins
#* Ties are settled by a tiebreaker
